entities.name: Hanno the Navigator
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carthaginian navigator (c. 500 BCE) who led a fleet of 60 ships with 30,000 colonists down the West African coast — the most ambitious recorded voyage of the ancient world. His Periplus describes encounters with gorillas, volcanic activity (likely Mount Cameroon), and lush tropical landscapes, reaching as far south as modern-day Gabon or Cameroon.
